about: Every file, dataset and tool the training of hey-lampas.json used, with its source, its licence and the licence's own words, read at the source on the date given (story mw-rdpwdp1.1; the hands-free entries, story mw-rdpwdp1.12). The model's weights are ours (MIT), made by scripts/wake-probe from the data below. The road-like noise and the room echo are made by scripts/wake-probe/probe.mjs itself, from no recording. Nothing below ships except the model. The road-like noise, the room echo and the car's microphone chain (noise suppressor, gain, CVSD, resamplers) are made by scripts/wake-probe from no recording.

entries.name: scripts/wake-probe (probe.mjs, detector.mjs, train.py, vits_say.py)
entries.use: makes the training audio, trains the network, sets the threshold, measures; detector.mjs is the scoring code
entries.words: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software

entries.name: scripts/wake-probe/handsfree.mjs (the car's Bluetooth hands-free microphone, simulated)
entries.use: puts the training audio, the threshold and measuring audio and the page's tries through a model of a car's microphone chain: road noise and the Bible leaking back, a spectral-gate noise suppressor, automatic gain, a narrowband (8 kHz, 300-3400 Hz, CVSD) or wideband (16 kHz, mSBC) link; plain JavaScript written for this repo, no code copied
entries.words: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software

entries.name: Bluetooth CVSD (continuously variable slope delta) codec parameters
entries.use: handsfree.mjs's cvsd() is written from the published parameters of the Bluetooth narrowband voice codec (64 kbit/s; step 10 to 1280 of 16-bit units, step decay 1 - 1/1024, accumulator decay 1 - 1/32, 4 equal bits to grow the step); no code is taken from any implementation; nothing of the specification ships
entries.where: GNU Radio's CVSD block documentation (accumulator decay 0.96875 = 1 - 1/32, J 4, 'modeled after the Bluetooth standard') and a US patent, 8,340,977, quoting Bluetooth Specification 2.0 (delta min 10, delta max 1280, beta 1 - 1/1024); the Bluetooth Core Specification (Vol 2, Part B) itself was not opened, so the values are as those two sources give them
entries.licence: parameters of a published standard; no licence needed for the numbers, none of the specification's text or any code is copied
entries.words: in accordance with Version 2.0 of the Bluetooth Specification, delta min=10, delta max=1280 and beta = 1 - 1/1024 for 64 kbit/s CVSD (patent text, as searched on 2026-11-11)

notUsed.name: Piper en_US-libritts_r-medium
notUsed.why: The story named it, and docs/wake-word-engines.md had it as permissive from its data (LibriTTS-R, CC BY 4.0). But its own card says "Fine-tuned from English lessac medium on train-clean-360", and the lessac medium card names its data as the Blizzard 2013 Lessac recordings, whose licence is for "Research Purposes" only and "excludes ... using the Materials for any commercial purpose, including the development, marketing, commercialisation, sale or licencing of voice synthesis or speech recognition products or services". So its weights are NOT CLEAN under this story's rules, and the VCTK VITS voice took its place.
